description: 3 lessons when designing your own life: 🍷 keep your eyes on your own paper  🍷 focus on sustainability and structure  🍷 opportunities are untouched until you touch them! #fyp #SoftAndAligned #lifebydesign #IntentionalLiving
transcript: It is so important for us to design our own lives, and it's important because that allows us to flourish. When we focus on creating sustainability and functionality in our lives, we're able to keep focus on our own tests. We are able to stay focused with what's in front of us on our paper, not looking at the person's test next to us. When we don't allow ourselves to be created, that is when we are unable to have our knowledge tested, and we do all this work, but we're too busy looking at what others are doing. Why not test the skills that we have? Also, there are opportunities. Opportunities are untouched until we touch them. Designing a life of function is taking control of the wheel.
